summary: {person} asks the wage office to check the tipped rate without naming the workers who called.
realLife: Denver Labor described receiving an anonymous report and finding several workers below the tipped minimum after examining payroll.
gates: The office has an anonymous tip about an employer and an applicable tipped rate.
weights: A specific workplace gives the office a way to check without naming a caller.
inGame: needs: the intake's confidentiality status and applicable tipped minimum.

turns.what: A worker chooses to go on record.
turns.pulledBy: The worker consents to a named statement.

turns.what: The caller gives only a branch name.
turns.writesBack: The inquiry starts at the named branch.
